user.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU)
user.description: Choose what to set up: monitoring stations (water temperature, level, discharge, flood danger) as a radius overview or a single favorite — or official bathing sites with their bathing water quality, plus the live bathing water temperature of the Zurich lake stations.

radius.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU)
radius.description: All FOEN/BAFU monitoring stations within this radius become devices with their measured values.

favorite.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU)
favorite.description: Pick one station by name — add the integration again for further favorites.

bathing_radius.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU) — bathing sites
bathing_radius.description: Every official bathing site within this radius becomes a device with its bathing water quality. The quality class is the seasonal assessment reported by the cantons (EU Bathing Water Directive), not a live reading. Lake stations within the radius additionally provide the live bathing water temperature.

bathing_favorite.title: Swiss Waters (BAFU) — bathing site
bathing_favorite.description: Pick one bathing site by name — add the integration again for further favourites. The Zurich lake stations (Tiefenbrunnen, Mythenquai) provide the live bathing water temperature.

reconfigure_radius.title: Change location or radius
reconfigure_radius.description: Change the location or the radius of this overview. Stations that stay inside the radius keep their entities, ids and history; stations that drop out are removed with their devices, and new ones are added after the reload.

reconfigure_favorite.title: Change station
reconfigure_favorite.description: Pick another station for this entry. The entities of the previous station are removed with its device; the new station gets its own.

reconfigure_bathing_radius.title: Change location or radius
reconfigure_bathing_radius.description: Change the location or the radius of this overview. Bathing sites that stay inside the radius keep their entities, ids and history; sites that drop out are removed with their devices, and new ones are added after the reload.

reconfigure_bathing_favorite.title: Change bathing site
reconfigure_bathing_favorite.description: Pick another bathing site for this entry. The entities of the previous site are removed with its device; the new site gets its own.

error.cannot_connect: The LINDAS data service could not be reached. Please try again later.
error.no_stations: No monitoring stations found within this radius. Try a larger radius.
error.no_sites: No bathing sites found within this radius. Try a larger radius.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.

flood_danger_level_reached.name: Flood danger level reached
flood_danger_level_reached.description: Triggers when the official flood danger level of a station rises to the minimum level or above (2 moderate, 3 considerable, 4 great, 5 very great). Fires once when the level is reached, not on every change above it.

water_temperature_crossed_threshold.name: Water temperature crossed a threshold
water_temperature_crossed_threshold.description: Triggers when the water temperature of a station crosses the threshold you set, for example your swimming limit.

water_level_crossed_threshold.name: Water level crossed a threshold
water_level_crossed_threshold.description: Triggers when the water level of a station crosses the threshold you set (metres above sea level, as the station reports it).

discharge_crossed_threshold.name: Discharge crossed a threshold
discharge_crossed_threshold.description: Triggers when the discharge of a station crosses the threshold you set, in cubic metres per second.

is_flood_danger_at_least.name: Flood danger level is at least
is_flood_danger_at_least.description: Passes while the official flood danger level of a station is at the level or above.

is_flood_danger_below.name: Flood danger level is below
is_flood_danger_below.description: Passes while the official flood danger level of a station is below the level.
